service.description: Live music for Colorado Springs corporate holiday parties, duo through quartet plus DJ, priced off the Denver column with one flat Front Range travel line.

faqs.q: Does a Colorado Springs booking cost more than a Denver one?
faqs.a: One flat travel line more, published on the rate card with everything else. Colorado Springs prices off the same column as Denver; the resort column is for the mountain corridor. Peak weekends and New Year's Eve carry the same published premiums they carry everywhere on the card.

faqs.q: Can you clear a defense contractor's vendor process?
faqs.a: Yes. We can be set up as a vendor, quote against a purchase order and invoice net-30 on approval, with a W-9 and a certificate of insurance naming your venue sent in the same email as the contract. Start onboarding when you shortlist dates; it is usually the slowest step in a corporate booking.

faqs.q: What size fits a Broadmoor-class ballroom party?
faqs.a: A quartet, once the floor has to fill. Dinner and remarks sit at 65 to 72 dBA, which a duo or trio holds comfortably; dancing runs 88 to 95 dBA, which is quartet work. One act can ladder across both halves of the night on a single contract.

faqs.q: Which dates does the season cover for Colorado Springs?
faqs.a: The same 21 published party dates as the whole Front Range: Thursdays through Saturdays across November and December, laid out with their peak premiums on our holiday season page. Whether one is free is a booking-calendar question, and it is our availability rather than any venue's, so check your venue's calendar in parallel and send us the date that clears both.
